entries.1715ee8177d52803: Since its founding in 1957, it has specialized in waterproofing work for buildings. The securities report states that in 1968 it carried out sealing waterproofing work for Mitsui Kasumigaseki Building, Japan's first super high-rise building, and acquired know-how in building sealing waterproofing ahead of other companies. A distinctive feature is that in addition to new waterproofing work, renovation work and directly contracted work, the company has a system in which equipment work is also received by the group.
